subject: architecture-maternal-covenant

metrics.what: The constitutional layer above AGISafe — the safety canons that govern all decisions
metrics.stack: Covenant > Policy > Threat > Measurement > Decision > Enforcement > Evidence
metrics.role: Defines the fundamental principles that AGISafe uses to make policy decisions
key_principles: AI must not cause harm to humans
AI must be transparent about its capabilities and limitations
AI must respect human autonomy and consent
AI must be accountable for its actions
AI must be subject to independent measurement
metrics.relationship: Maternal Covenant = constitution. AGISafe = legislature. CSOAI = judiciary (measurement). ASISecurity = executive (enforcement).
metrics.agi_safe_integration: AGISafe's decision engine reads covenant principles + CSOAI measurements → outputs policy decisions aligned with constitutional values

honest_sentence: The Maternal Covenant is the constitutional layer — published Jan 2026. Defines safety canons that AGISafe uses for policy decisions. Covenant > Policy > Threat > Measurement > Decision > Enforcement > Evidence.
